content.comment_body: Hello all, excited to join the discussion for the first time. I'm trying to download a macro for eplan. Previously, I could search by the specific article number and download the macro directly. Now, it appears that everything must be accessed through the download manager. I followed this process and was only able to download an excel file—there was no edz or similar macro file included. I'm not sure if I've missed a step or if the process has changed. Any guidance would be appreciated! (I'm looking for the macro associated with [article_no]) Thanks!

Hello [user_name], You are searching for the EPLAN macro for a SIPLUS [product_name] 24CE. This item is based on [article_no]. Try using this article number to find the correct EPLAN macro. The download manager sometimes provides downloads even when the required data isn't present. For a single device, I recommend using the Industry Image Database, which lets you enter an article number to view all available photos, graphics, and CAx files. Best regards [user_name]
Fantastic—thanks for your help! I successfully downloaded the macro. Great suggestion to use the Image Database; I found it much more convenient. Thanks again!

analysis.insight_summary: The user tried to download an EPLAN macro for a particular device using its article number but received only an Excel file instead of the expected macro (EDZ) file. The procedure had changed to require use of a download manager, which led to incomplete results. Another user advised searching in the Industry Image Database for better access to CAx files, which solved the problem.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to find and download the correct macro (EDZ file) directly via product article number search, as was possible previously.
